We evaluate our method on three long-context benchmarks: (1) LongBench , a realistic and diverse benchmark where we evaluate on all tasks, including QA, fewshot learning, code generation, summarization, and counting; (2) RULER , a challenging benchmark with tasks such as hay-in-thestack, KV retrieval, variable tracking, and QA, evaluated at input lengths from 4K to 128K with 200 samples per task; (3) GSM-Infinite , a benchmark designed to assess mathematical reasoning under long-generation settings, where we evaluate on Medium and Hard tasks with context lengths of 8K, 16K and 32K.
